intro: I build models in Python and scikit-learn, LLM apps and RAG with LangChain, and I ship AI products with AI coding assistants.

ask.question: What has Sangam built on his own?
ask.answer: On his own: a credit risk model tuned to catch defaulters (0.76 ROC-AUC, 41.8% of defaulters caught at a 15% threshold), customer segments with K-Means served by FastAPI on AWS EC2, and a house price model that explains 83% of the variance. ProfilePilot and DealShield AI were built by AI coding assistants from his ideas, and he launched them.

quote: Work until your signature becomes an autograph.
